metadata.name: workerbee-read-only-resource-contracts
metadata.description: Read-only MCP resource contracts with bounded mutation tool references.

spec.mutation_model: Resources expose read-only project context. Mutations remain behind explicit, bounded WorkerBee tools with project/target scope.

resources.name: projects
resources.describes: known project identities, cwd, branch, mode, and dashboard links

resources.name: status
resources.describes: project stack, workload, ingress, runbook, and mode status

resources.name: routes
resources.describes: WorkerBee-managed dashboard, API, docs, and workload ingress routes

resources.name: security
resources.describes: secret policy state, advisory security findings, and hardening metadata

resources.name: trace
resources.describes: per-project operation timeline and evidence references

resources.name: profiles
resources.describes: built-in k1s profile shapes and runtime requirements

resources.name: targets
resources.describes: target manager mutation boundaries for local, remote, OpenStack-compatible k1s, and export lanes
